name: Music lessons

pf.license.need: none found for private music lessons or piano tuning: identity is checked, the business gives its registration, and a person on Rosie's team checks the state's site within 1 business day
pf.license.who: the business (its registration); no person license for teachers
pf.license.background: a background check for anyone who teaches students under 18 where the state's rules require it, or where the owner turns it on; Rosie shows only what the owner states (who ran it, what it covered, the date), never just 'background checked'
pf.license.blocks: nothing blocks going live but the ID check; a teacher who needs a background check (by the state's rules or the owner's) is offered for students under 18 only once the owner marks it on file
pf.license.renewals: a background check's renew-by date is reminded 30 days before; a lapsed one stops new bookings with students under 18 for that teacher
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, or a host's place asks for proof
pf.license.teachers: a teacher who runs their own studio is their own business: their own prices and Stripe

pf.services.shape: private lessons with a chosen teacher; the instrument picks who can teach it, and the length (30 or 45 minutes, 60 for audition prep) sets the price
pf.services.examples: the example studio's own prices (Lee Music Studio and Lee Music Lessons), not a standard

pf.services.rooms: each studio lesson needs a lesson room with the instrument; the example studio has 2 piano rooms
pf.services.hours: the example studio: Mon–Fri 10:00am–8:00pm and Sat 9:00am–5:00pm; home lessons Mon–Fri 3:00–8:00pm and Sat mornings
pf.services.online: lessons by video at the studio's price; the teacher's video link goes in the confirmation and reminder
pf.services.capacity: one student per lesson; siblings book back to back

beforeTimes: the instrument (or voice), and the length: 30 or 45 minutes (60 for audition prep)
the level: never played, beginner, or plays already
at the studio, at home or online
a trial lesson, a single lesson, or weekly lessons
afterTime: anything the teacher should know that isn't private (a piece the student is working on, an instrument at home or not)
for a home lesson: the address, parking, and where the piano or a quiet room is
securePage: the student's first name and age
18 or older, and the parent or guardian of a student under 18
any learning, health or hearing notes the teacher should know (optional)
who may pick up a student 10 or older (the pick-up list)
photos or video at lessons and recitals: yes or no
the first name to print in a recital program, only with the parent's yes
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a student under 18, from age 5; a teen who books is asked to send the link to a parent

stop.words: a student hurt or very unwell at a lesson: hard to breathe, a fall, an allergy reaction
stop.say: Call 911 now. The teacher stays with the student.
stop.booking: the lesson stops; the parent and Sam are told at once

goOn.words: a student who's sick or has a fever before a lesson
goOn.what: the lesson moves free, or goes online, as the studio's rules say

goOn.words: words that a child may be unsafe
goOn.what: sent to Sam at once, privately, and to the authorities where the state's rules require it; never answered by the AI

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

pf.first_steps.steps: none: a trial lesson is booked as its own lesson, never as a step before another
pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: bring the instrument (violin, voice music) and the lesson book; for a trial, the teacher brings a loaner violin and checks the size; a student under 10 comes with a parent, who stays in the building; for a home lesson, a quiet room with the piano

pf.visit.checkIn: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk or the lesson room door; at home: the code from the adult who answers the door; online: the code read out at the start of the video call
pf.visit.minors: under 10: a parent or guardian stays in the building; 10 and older may wait alone and go home only with an adult on the pick-up list; at home: an adult stays home for the whole lesson; lesson room doors have windows
pf.visit.beforeWork: the teacher checks what the student practiced and the piece in the notes from last time
pf.visit.changes: more time (an extra 15 minutes) only if the teacher is free next, priced and OK'd first; a late student gets the time left, and the lesson ends on time
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the teacher; the teacher's practice notes go to the parent on a private page

pf.money.before: a card saved for the $20 fee (the studio) or the $40 fee (home lessons); a trial paid in full; a term or the first month of a monthly plan paid in full on the page
pf.money.after: each lesson charged to the saved card after it, or paid at the front desk where Sam sets it
pf.money.caps: deposit and prepay caps: from the state form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel or skip until 24 hours before (the owner's setting)
pf.money.fees: a late cancel or no-show: $20 at the studio, $40 for a home lesson, a trial's $25; the owner confirms each one, and no answer means no fee
pf.money.makeups: a lesson missed with 24 hours' notice, a teacher out or the studio closed: a make-up within 30 days, or a refund for a prepaid lesson; a late cancel or no-show: no make-up unless Sam offers one; never a fee when the studio changes the plan
pf.money.plans: weekly lessons and the monthly plan need their own yes; 30 days' notice of a price change; stopped by one reply or on the page; a yearly reminder of the terms where the state's rules require it
pf.money.tips: none: the studio takes no tips, and Rosie never asks for one
pf.money.tax: a tax line only for books or strings sold, where the state's rules require it
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies: once a month for a plan, once for a recital spot

pf.messages.never: a student's age, school, learning, health or hearing notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page; texts name a student by first name only
pf.messages.minors: a student under 18 gets no texts: they go to the parent or guardian who booked
pf.messages.selling: no instrument rentals, sales or offers in booking texts; renting an instrument is between the family and a shop

pf.staff.skills: each teacher's instruments and the ages they teach; only teachers of an instrument are offered for it (only Elena teaches violin at the example studio)
pf.staff.checks: a background check on file before teaching students under 18, where the state's rules or the owner require it
pf.staff.supervision: a student teacher or assistant teaches only while a teacher is in the building, where the owner sets it
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs home lessons from the studio, a new student's first lesson at the studio, same-day lessons, and any make-up past 30 days
pf.staff.standIn: a stand-in teaches the same instrument, with the last lesson's notes

pf.rules.plans: repeat plans: the price, how often and how to stop sit next to their own yes; reminders and notice periods where the state's rules require them
pf.rules.minors: who must stay with a minor, and background checks for people who teach minors, where the state's rules require them
pf.rules.photos: a minor's photo, video or name in a recital program only with the parent's yes
pf.rules.records: lesson notes and the booking kept 7 years, or as the state's rules say
pf.rules.receipt: what a receipt must show, where the state's rules require it

pf.edges.lateArrival: the lesson ends on time; no make-up for lost minutes
pf.edges.teacherLate: a teacher running late gives the full lesson, or a new time with no fee
pf.edges.missed: a late skip or no-show: Sam decides the fee and any make-up; no answer, no fee
pf.edges.makeup: make-ups are offered by text with times to pick; Sam is asked before one runs past 30 days
pf.edges.closure: snow or a teacher out: every family gets a new time or a refund, never a fee
pf.edges.recital: a recital is set on a date that can't move: families sign up on a page, get the order and call time, and check in at the door; a teacher out that day gets a stand-in accompanist
pf.edges.pickUp: a student 10 or older goes home only with an adult on the pick-up list
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
pf.edges.leftEarly: the example studio's own rule: a student who leaves early is charged the lesson as booked; Sam can lower it with PART

notes:
From: hair. Music lessons run like the hair pilot: one-to-one lessons booked with a named teacher, the length setting the price. Yoga's term-and-seat model doesn't fit private lessons; its packs and plans are master branches (A5-01, A5-22, A5-21) that this overlay fills with the fall term and the monthly plan.
Which side is usual: the old flowchart's studio (Larkspur) books lessons at the studio; home lessons cost more and ask the owner first. So flow A, the studio, is the usual side, and online lessons by video count as a third place in flow A (A4-01, A4-36). Flow B draws lessons at the student's home in full.
Names: Sam Lee's main company is Lee Music Lessons LLC (teachers go to students' homes, with piano tuning as its second kind of work, 15 Harbor Rd); the second company is Lee Music Studio LLC (the studio, 250 Cedar Ave). Teachers: Elena (piano, violin, voice) and Marcus (piano, voice) at the studio; Daniel (piano, violin, tuning) and Felix (piano, guitar) at homes. Alex's home: 9 Aspen Ct. Students: Lily, 8 (flow A) and Noah, 11 (flow B).
Daniel and Felix are men and Elena's pronouns are never used, so the master's 'he' for its home pro stays right.
Prices are the example studio's own, not a standard: piano 30 min $35, 45 min $55, voice and violin $40, extra 15 minutes $20, trial $25, monthly plan $140 (4 weekly lessons), fall term $420 (12 lessons), audition prep $70 for 60 minutes; at home 30 min $55, 45 min $75, trial $45, fee $40; piano tuning $150. The master's $35, $20 and $40 are kept; the master's $55 becomes the $25 trial, $179 the $75 home lesson, $89 the $40 fee, $150 the $45 home trial.
Money paths, from how lessons are really paid: a lesson charged to the saved card after it (both flows; also weekly lessons, the old flowchart's plan), a trial paid in full when booking (both), and a lesson paid at the studio's front desk with a card saved for the fee (flow A). A fall term or the first month of a monthly plan is paid in full on the page (the full path's A5-22 branch), and a lesson from it uses a credit (A5-03). No holds, deposits, photo quotes or prices set at the visit: lessons never take them.
Sign-up words changed to how music lessons are paid (S1-12 to S1-17, S1-21, S1-41, S1-42, S1-45, S1-47): the main company saves a card for the $40 fee and charges it after each lesson; the studio saves a card for the $20 fee; the trial and the term are paid in full. In flow B's full path S1-15 still shows Sam's answer 1, as the master's picker sets it there.
The trial's terms: a late cancel or a no-show may keep the whole trial price ($25 studio, $45 home), with Sam's OK; no answer in 24 hours means a full refund. All the master's '$20 fee kept, $35 refunded' full-path lines are reworded so the sums stay right.
Free cancel: 24 hours before (the owner's setting). Flow B moves from 7am-the-same-day to 4pm the day before, and its main lesson from an 8-10am window to a 4:00pm set start after school (B4-83 keeps only 'A set start time'). Every Thursday clock on the main path is moved to match: OMW 3:35pm, check-in 4:00pm, DONE 4:45pm (4:30pm for the 30-minute trial), receipt 4:50pm, rating 7:00pm.
A parent books for a minor: flow A's main lesson is for Lily, so A4-24 points to the child branch (A4-70, A4-25 reworded); flow B adds its own step B4-x01 on the main path. The student's name, age and any learning or health notes go only on the secure page (A4-42 and B4-29 screens); texts go only to the parent and name the student by first name.
Under 10 a parent stays in the building; 10 and older may be left and goes home only with an adult on the pick-up list (A8-67 keeps both branches, A8-42 reworded). At home an adult stays for the whole lesson (B8-67 keeps 'An adult must be there').
Missed lessons and make-ups: own branch A7-x01..x03 (a prepaid lesson skipped with notice becomes a make-up within 30 days; no pick: Sam picks refund or 30 more days; silence refunds) and B7-x01..x02 (the teacher out: make-ups, never a charge). A late cancel or no-show keeps the master's fee steps; a used prepaid lesson is a fee Sam confirms (A5-03).
The recital as an event: own branch A10-x01..x04 (studio recital, sign-up page with the $25 fee, program order and call time, check-in at the door) and B10-x01..x03 (a hall recital for home students). Only families who said yes to studio news get the invite (a new row on the secure page), since S13-09 keeps booking texts to the booking.
Recital $2: a recital spot is its own booking, so Rosfield's $2 counts once, at the door check-in. Make-ups are part of the same booking or plan: no new $2.
Off in both flows: licenses (lessons and tuning need none; registration only), sent now, classes, spaces, first steps, damage holds, a crew, a minimum, the plan-or-insurance branches, weather, parts and ordered items, notices for sales at home, permits, drop-offs, rentals, items left. Off in A: the audition-prep quote (S11-08: every studio price is on the board), walk-ins except 'no walk-ins', the date that can't move (the recital carries its own), the forgotten-item stop, the skin problem, several-day visits, the proposal, the free fix, results later. Off in B: the live line, safety steps first, the more-work, bigger-job, landlord, hazard, update, delivery, several-days and part-to-shop branches, extras and the right to cancel them, the warranty claim, the report, the faucet and the fan, the proposal.
Teachers hold no state license; a background check for teaching students under 18 is a plug-in switch (the state's rules or the owner's), shown only as the owner stated it (S2-29 more, S11-50, S11-51, S2-21 table).
Late students get the time left and the lesson ends on time (A7-70 'Shorter'); a teacher running late still gives the full lesson. A student leaving early is charged as booked (A8-37), the example studio's rule.
Section 11 what-ifs use only real lesson money: S11-56 switches voice lessons to the saved card (A) and the home trial to a card saved (B); S11-09 in B is an 8-lesson summer plan with a card saved, not a deposit; S11-58 adds instrument repair in both flows.
Danger: the plug-in adds no words that stop a booking beyond the general check; words that a child may be unsafe go to Sam privately (pf.safety). The 'safety steps, then go on' branch is off in both flows.
Instrument rental stays outside Rosie and out of booking texts (pf.messages), as the old flowchart's rule says.
Review, Oct 23: audition prep is a board price ($70, 60 minutes), not a quote from the student's answers: lessons are list-priced, and no photos path is listed. S1-47 asks instead whether a new student's first lesson comes to Sam (its rules card already said so). S12-20's higher-price branches are off in both flows; flow B keeps the summer-lessons quote over $500 (S11-08).
Review, Oct 23: the example studio is open Mon–Fri 10:00am–8:00pm and Sat 9:00am–5:00pm, so section 11's Friday lessons fit; Lily's offered times move off Sunday and school hours (Mon Oct 26 and Tue Oct 27, 4:00pm).
Review, Oct 23: texts name a student by first name only (Lily, Noah), also in staff texts; a student who needs help is told to Sam with no health detail (A8-38). Practice notes go on a private page in both flows (B10-22).
Review, Oct 23: the trial's whole $25 (A) or $45 (B) may be kept, so no card says 'Refund' when it is kept (A7-08, A8-20, A8-62).
